description: Bold creative-brief editorial presentation template: fiery solid vermilion, black ink and warm off-white paper; massive condensed uppercase grotesque headlines (system stacks only), tracked-out kickers, thick black rules, oversized type colliding with image frames, and editorial numbering. Mixes dark statement slides with light content slides. Cover, agenda, big statement, punch list, two-column, stat block, giant quote, CSS/SVG visual interlude, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
name: Ember
